manual.large_constructions.line2: {0}Not all machinery can be bundled up into simple packages and shipped directly to consumer. For every charging station, there are two constructions behind it that need more space.{1}
manual.large_constructions.line3: Large furnaces that need to bulk process, coking furnaces that need meters of insulation, all of these cannot fit within a simple meter by meter cube.{0}
manual.large_constructions.line4: Multiblock constructions, large machines, are the answer to this: built and then assembled, rather than constructed on a bench.{0}
manual.large_constructions.line5: When assembled from their constituent parts with the Engineer's Hammer, they provide the industrial backing any self-respecting engineer needs for their factories.
